title: Stocks Fall as Inflation Jitters Boost Bond Yields: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks joined bonds lower as a rally in oil prices stoked worries about inflationary pressures, which were further reinforced by data showing jump in US business activity at the fastest pace since 2021.

title: Spain’s Sánchez Says China Talks Can Help EU Cut Trade Deficit
summary: The European Union should aim to negotiate an agreement that rebalances its trading relationship with China rather than get dragged into a damaging dispute, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said.

title: USD rallies after US data aided case for Federal Reserve increases
summary: The dollar jumped Wednesday after US business activity rose at the fastest pace in more than five years, fortifying the case for the Federal Reserve to continue raising interest rates.

summary: Shares of the largest exchange-traded fund tracking long-dated Treasuries closed at a record low as the yearslong bond market selloff shows few signs of relenting.

title: 'It's All About Culture' in the 'War for Talent'
summary:
The M&A firm Weil is eyeing its own merger options as top leaders within the firm are leaving.
Weil Partner Michael Aiello explains the factors he is weighing as he gets ready to join a new firm, and JPMorgan Global Head of M&A Charlie Bouckaert describes the "war for talent." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Bond-Market Slide Deepens, Pushing Yields to Two-Decade Highs
summary: The losses in the US Treasuries market intensified on Wednesday as robust economic data and a weak debt auction drove yields across most maturities to the highest levels in almost two decades.

title: Peloton Holds Talks for Potential $800 Million Debut Bond Deal
summary: Peloton Interactive Inc. is eyeing its first-ever bond deal, sounding out investors for a potential $800 million sale, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: Gold Falls as Inflation Fears Revive Fed Interest-Rate Hike Bets
summary: Gold fell as renewed strength in energy prices, particularly oil, and the latest US data on manufacturing and services reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates to fight inflation.

title: Nvidia Among Top Traded US Credit Swaps as Hedging Demand Soars
summary: Derivatives tied to Nvidia Corp. are now among the most traded in the US credit default swaps market, as investors seek to hedge their exposure to the firm’s debt in the wake of June’s $25 billion bond sale.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 23
summary: US diesel futures slumped as speculation swirled that the White House is considering an export ban, with key refinery infrastructure around the globe still offline.

title: Copper Snaps Six-Day Rally as Inflation Concerns Cool Metals
summary: Copper retreated from close to a record as an upswing in oil prices and strong US economic data stoked concerns about higher US interest rates.

title: European Union Needs to Reduce Dependency on China, Says Spain's Prime Minister
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said that the European Union needs to reduce its dependency on China and rebalance its dependence on other economies.  Sanchez, who sat down with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua, said that one of the EU's strengths its is willingness to open its economies to other regions.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Arizona Senator Mark Kelly to Introduce New AI Workforce Bill
summary: Democrat Senator from Arizona Mark Kelly discussed his plans to unveil a new bill aimed at mitigating AI impact on the workforce and said that it is important to generate revenue from AI companies to 'give people options.' Kelly also weighed in on President Trump's summit with China's President Xi and said he does not expect the president to have a serious negotiation on AI with his Chinese counterpart.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Disney+ Price to Jump 13% as Soon as Wednesday
summary:
Walt Disney Co. is raising prices on several of its streaming subscriptions, with users being notified as early as Wednesday, according to people familiar with the matter. 
Bloomberg Intelligence US Media Analyst Geetha Ranganathan discusses the price jump and what it signals for the company and the broader streaming market. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oil Companies Taking Advantage of American Public, Says Rep. Burchett
summary: Representative Tim Burchett, a Tennessee Republican, wants to restrict diesel exports and says 'the American public is getting gouged.' Burchett said that big oil companies are 'compounding the problem' with prices at the pump and taking advantage of the American public because they have a monopoly on the industry.  (Source: Bloomberg)
